image_description: A close-up photograph of an adult guenon monkey holding a juvenile infant. The adult has olive-brown fur with a lighter underbelly and a distinctive facial ruff. The face is bare with dark skin, forward-facing eyes, and a narrow nose. The infant is nestled against the adult's chest, looking towards the viewer. The background is blurred natural foliage.

Both the adult and infant have forward-facing eyes. The irises appear dark brown/black, consistent with the species description.
The nasal structure is narrow and prominent, typical of Old World monkeys.
Ears are visible on the adult, partially obscured by the facial ruff, appearing small and rounded.
